thread:
Elena P: Quick capture from today's AH Q&A thread. Putting the follow-ups here so owners can pick and we can send a single announcement. Short and actionable.

Samir B: Question on cost controls for Hosted vs Dedicated—are we exposing token caps per-route or only account-level quotas?

Maya L: Plan is both: account-level quota + optional per-route soft caps with webhook notifications. I'll add language & example JSON for the API.

Tess R: Live thread asked about routing fallback order if a model variant fails its health check. Do we go to a smaller quantized version or switch region?

Elena P: Fallback priority: same-region compatible quantized variant -> same-region different model (if latency ok) -> cross-region cheapest compatible. We pause rollouts during active failovers.

Kyle W: Need a short ops playbook for that (health detection thresholds, automated switch, and customer-notify template). I'll draft runbook and a notification email template.

Samir B: Also asked if burst credits for Dedicated trials will be applied automatically or require support to enable.

Maya L: We'll auto-grant a small burst for the first 14 days; larger bursts via support request. I'll put exact limits in the billing doc.

Elena P: Owners so far:
- Maya L: billing quota + burst policy + sample API quota JSON
- Kyle W: ops playbook + notification templates
- Samir B: product copy for the announcement and FAQ section
- Tess R: routing fallback doc and sequence diagrams

Action checklist (canary week):
- [ ] Billing snippet + quota JSON (Maya)
- [ ] Runbook + notify templates (Kyle)
- [ ] Announcement + FAQ copy (Samir)
- [ ] Routing fallback doc (Tess)
